step1_analysis.circuit_type: Two-stage fully differential operational transconductance amplifier (OTA)
step1_analysis.description: A fully differential OTA consisting of a telescopic cascode first stage and a common-source second stage. It is designed to provide high DC gain and bandwidth, likely used as the core amplifier in the switched-capacitor circuits of the pipeline ADC stages.

paper_reference.title: Oversampled Pipeline A/D Converters With Mismatch Shaping

sky130_expected.calculation: First stage (telescopic) gain ~ gm*ro^2 (~50 dB), second stage (common-source) gain ~ gm*ro (~25 dB). Total expected ~75 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: 76 dB is a standard and achievable target for a two-stage cascode OTA in modern processes, matching the paper's reported value.

sky130_expected.calculation: GBW = gm1 / (2*pi*Cc). Assuming load compensation with 1pF and gm1 ~ 1mS, GBW ~ 160 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 61 MHz reported in the paper is easily achievable in SKY130 1.8V with appropriate biasing and load capacitance.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin at unity gain frequency

paper_reported.value: 180 ph (likely refers to phase shift or margin)

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the non-dominant pole location relative to GBW. With 1pF load, the second stage pole might be dominant or non-dominant.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A stable OTA requires at least 45-60 degrees of phase margin. The exact value depends on the compensation scheme (load vs Miller).

sky130_expected.calculation: I_total * VDD. If each branch has ~1mA, total current ~3mA. Power = 3mA * 1.8V = 5.4mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scales with the required GBW and load capacitance. 5-8 mW is typical for a high-speed pipeline ADC op-amp.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for measuring DC gain, GBW, phase margin, and power of the fully differential OTA. Includes ideal CMFB networks to stabilize the operating point.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Two-Stage Fully Differential OTA Testbench

.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xmn4=5u L_xmn4=0.5u
.param W_xmp13=5u L_xmp13=0.5u
.param W_xmn15=5u L_xmn15=0.5u
.param W_xmp9=5u L_xmp9=0.5u
.param W_xmp5=5u L_xmp5=0.5u
.param W_xmp6=5u L_xmp6=0.5u
.param W_xmp10=5u L_xmp10=0.5u
.param W_xmn3=5u L_xmn3=0.5u
.param W_xmn16=5u L_xmn16=0.5u
.param W_xmn1=5u L_xmn1=0.5u
.param W_xmp14=5u L_xmp14=0.5u
.param W_xmnt2=5u L_xmnt2=0.5u
.param W_xmn2=5u L_xmn2=0.5u
.param W_xmnt1=5u L_xmnt1=0.5u

XMN4 N15 N3 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn4} w={W_xmn4}
XMP13 N11 BIAS5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp13} w={W_xmp13}
XMN15 N11 N14 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn15} w={W_xmn15}
XMP9 N2 BIAS4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp9} w={W_xmp9}
XMP5 N15 LABEL_NET_0 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp5} w={W_xmp5}
XMP6 N17 N9 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp6} w={W_xmp6}
XMP10 N5 BIAS4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp10} w={W_xmp10}
XMN3 N17 N7 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn3} w={W_xmn3}
XMN16 N8 N15 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn16} w={W_xmn16}
XMN1 N6 VI_PLUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn1} w={W_xmn1}
XMP14 N8 BIAS5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp14} w={W_xmp14}
XMNT2 N0 STAGE2_CMFB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmnt2} w={W_xmnt2}
XMN2 N4 VI_MINUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn2} w={W_xmn2}
XMNT1 N1 STAGE1_CMFB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmnt1} w={W_xmnt1}

* Fix missing connection between first stage output and second stage input
Rshort N14 N17 1m

* Power supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Biasing
VBIAS4 BIAS4 0 1.0
VBIAS5 BIAS5 0 1.0
VN3 N3 0 1.3
VN7 N7 0 1.3
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.5
VN9 N9 0 0.5

* Ideal CMFB to set output common-mode to 0.9V
B1 STAGE1_CMFB 0 V=0.7 + 10*(V(N15) + V(N17) - 1.8)
B2 STAGE2_CMFB 0 V=0.7 + 10*(V(N8) + V(N11) - 1.8)

* Inputs
V_INP VI_PLUS 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5 sin(0.9 0.1 10Meg)
V_INN VI_MINUS 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5 sin(0.9 -0.1 10Meg)

* Load capacitors
CL1 N8 0 1p
CL2 N11 0 1p

* Differential output voltage source for easy measurement
Ediff OUT_DIFF 0 N11 N8 1.0

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(OUT_DIFF)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(OUT_DIFF))

meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_at_gbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

tran 1n 200n
meas tran v_max max v(OUT_DIFF)
meas tran v_min min v(OUT_DIFF)
.endc
.end
